current_status: provisional initial ATAC snapshot; final QC and identities pending
delivery: offline local directory; HTML, scripts, lazy coordinate files and vendor library stay together

activity_records.duplicates: Identical rows repeated across canonical panels are collapsed; conflicting values fail build.
activity_records.aggregation: Merge selected source clusters with n_cells weighting within each animal, then take an unweighted mean across represented animals. Raw display is mean integer activity sum / nucleus within animal, then equal-animal mean. Normalized display uses saved mean log1p(activity / full-cell activity total * 10000).
activity_records.zscore: Population SD of the displayed equal-animal normalized means for each gene across currently displayed groups; zero variance gives 0. Color clipped at +/-2.5, exported numeric z is unclipped.
activity_records.missing: Unmapped feature values are NA, never evidence of absent biology. Exports have null / blank numeric plot values and mapped=false.
activity_records.ranking: Descriptive differences within the preselected 107-gene activity panel only. Genome-wide top markers await final filtered analysis.
activity_records.inference: No p-values or disease effects inferred from interactive plots. Animal is the biological replicate.

coordinate_adapter.axis_validation: Exact producer H5 cell index equality with streamed metadata; matching exported row order.
coordinate_adapter.read_scope: Only /obsm/X_umap_initial, /obsm/X_umap_initial_uncorrected and /obs/cell_id were read from the atlas. Raw X CSR and LSI matrices were not scanned.
coordinate_adapter.sampling: All initial atlas points are exported and drawn; no synthetic or sampled coordinates.
coordinate_adapter.feature_overlays: Require separate cell-axis-bound feature vectors with source and normalization semantics. Gene-body activity must never be labeled RNA expression.

display_labels.validation: Known source cluster IDs and strings of 1-80 characters; imports from other datasets rejected.
display_labels.merge: Repeated display labels combine plotted summaries only; original source cluster and raw matrices are immutable.
display_labels.final_annotation: Must be provided by independently reviewed scientific output; browser display labels do not become final metadata.

future_adapters.final_QC: Reviewed retained cell IDs, all pass/fail flags and thresholds, doublet/mitochondrial/empty sensitivity, animal/type retention and exact source axes.
future_adapters.RNA_SCT: Raw integer counts stay separate from SCT residuals. Include actual runtime and fit/transform provenance, feature coverage, clipping/floor semantics, PCA/Harmony and matched uncorrected embeddings.
future_adapters.cell_types: Reviewed identity, confidence/evidence/unknown state, 10-20 supported top markers per type, no required forced labels.
future_adapters.RNA_ATAC_transfer: Validated independent RNA labels, cross-assay mapping method, prediction scores and unknown/low-confidence states. These nuclei are not one-to-one paired.
future_adapters.TE: Explicit RNA expression versus ATAC accessibility feature dictionary at locus/subfamily/family, raw assignment mode, multimapping/ambiguity policy, denominator and count-conservation proofs, cell axis and raw integer pseudobulk where applicable.
future_adapters.differential: Raw animal x reviewed cluster/type feature counts, sample metadata, design rank, age-matched genotype contrasts, sex term, effect size, uncertainty, filtering and multiple-testing metadata. Expected fractional sensitivity counts are distinct from integer observed-count models.
future_adapters.coverage: Genome build, exact gene/TE intervals, assay, animal/type/genotype group, strand/cut/fragment policy, blacklist/mappability, normalization denominator, scaled track values and source identity. TSS/TES/gene-body windows defined explicitly.
future_adapters.atlas_expansion: New adapters must declare available/absent features; the UI must not populate unavailable RNA, TE or track views with initial ATAC values.

figure_exports.rendering: canvas figure embedded as high-resolution raster image in PDF; context text is PDF text; not fully vector

dotplot: selected-value min/max for raw and normalized
UMAP: full selected-color category legend with matching palette
native_legends.animal_boxplot: condition axis in canvas plus explicit point and quartile/range explanation

cluster_resolution_adapters.marker_summary_policy: Never reuse resolution-0.6 cluster summaries for resolution-1.0 labels. UMAP coordinates may be reused with actual new per-cell labels.
